To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) privatisation is not a panacea; (b) it is a complex process that involves significant change in organisational structures and culture; (c) it has a profound impact on the environment of the privatised entity; and (d) the change process can be managed effectively.

The changes to culture were more extensive than the changes to organisational structure (e.g. the size and nature of management),

privatised organisations are more likely than not to have: 1. Changed their organisational structures; 2. Increased their use of performance indicators; 3. In summary, our research is concerned with
the cultural changes associated with privatisation, particularly the changes to organisational structure and the cultural profile.
the impact of privatisation on organisational structures, cultures, and environments of the privatised entities.
the effects of privatisation on the organisational structure and culture of organisations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
privatisation does change organisational structure, culture and environment.
privatisation has resulted in cultural changes in the affected entities.
the cultural changes are not trivial but are significant and are not limited to the electricity industry in Australia.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the survey results support the proposition that privatisation has resulted in significant cultural changes in affected entities.
privatisation is a process of change, which involves a number of changes, some of which are not always obvious.
privatisation does not necessarily lead to a change of culture but, in the majority of cases, it will do so.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cultural change that occurs after privatisation is more important to the success of a business than the organisational structure change that occurs.
privatisation is not a panacea for the problems faced by government-owned enterprises.
privatisation is associated with significant cultural change.
